Laravel#

This page wires Rollcall into a Laravel app. Next: use it from your coding agent (ADVISOR).

The package registers itself (extra.laravel.providers). Publish the config with php artisan vendor:publish --tag=rollcall-config, set the variables in the configuration reference, and schedule rollcall:scan. The dashboard shows counts and progress; the per-app page is a second route that stays off until you enable it, and it runs behind rollcall.dashboard.internal_middleware (default web and auth.sesame), so an app with no such middleware fails closed. The page uses WayneUI's class names and takes its stylesheet from ROLLCALL_WAYNEUI_CSS. The /metrics route is registered on its own path; if your app already serves /metrics (HELMET does), run Rollcall's on a separate app or leave metrics off.
